concept: NACL vs Security Group: deny rule to block an IP
tests: Distinguishing NACLs from Security Groups: only NACLs support deny, and rules are evaluated by number.
expected: A Network ACL inbound deny for the IP with a lower rule number than the allow. Triggers: "block a single IP", "all instances in a subnet", "keep other traffic".
why_not: Security Groups support allow only; a route table routes by destination and does not filter sources; an "IGW filter rule" does not exist.
